term: same selected necessary root with esse maximality and perfection
definition: There exists ONE witness n that is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w, necessary at accessible worlds, equal to every other selected actual root, maximal in the supplied esse respect, and universally perfect in the existing formal-or-eminent InAct sense. This concerns selected actual roots, not uniqueness of all necessary individuals or rootness in every world. InAct, GoodIn and CausesIn are supplied global dictionaries; their world correspondence, formal-or-eminent meaning and causal applicability remain OPEN. No God predicate, naming, moral perfection, omniscience, explanatory sufficiency or philosophical premise truth is established.
note: Packages existing ActualRoot, NecessaryAt, selected root uniqueness, IsMaximumIn, IsPerfect with a shared existential witness. No new attribute semantics or source reading.
